brief: Choose a feasible housing or transport adjustment using the household’s stated accessibility and time constraints.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Feasible Choices"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Elige un plan combinado viable"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Escolha um plano conjunto viável"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Choose a feasible housing or transport adjustment using the household’s stated accessibility and time constraints.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: The cheapest location may not work for daily life; check money, time and access together.
instruction.misconception: The lowest rent is always best even when transport, time or accessibility makes the option unusable.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: First filter options by essential access and timing. Then compare combined housing and transport costs among feasible options.
An unusable entrance fails the stated access requirement.
A route must operate when the journey is needed.
Affordable rent does not fix unavailable essential access.
Unknown timing prevents checking the arrival constraint.
B has the lower combined cost among these feasible options.
B is the only option meeting every stated essential constraint.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: The cheapest location may not work for daily life; check money, time and access together.

es-MX.line: La ubicación más barata puede no funcionar para la vida diaria; revisa juntos dinero, tiempo y acceso.

pt-BR.line: O local mais barato pode não servir para o dia a dia; confira juntos dinheiro, tempo e acesso.

en-US.line: First filter options by essential access and timing. Then compare combined housing and transport costs among feasible options.

es-MX.line: Primero filtra opciones por acceso y horarios esenciales. Luego compara vivienda y transporte combinados entre opciones viables.

pt-BR.line: Primeiro filtre opções por acesso e horários essenciais. Depois compare moradia e transporte juntos entre opções viáveis.

en-US.prompt: Which option meets the stated need?
en-US.scene: Ana requires step-free entry; A has stairs only, B has a working accessible entrance.
help: Check essential accessibility before comparing price.

feedback.met: An unusable entrance fails the stated access requirement.
feedback.not_yet: Check essential accessibility before comparing price.

es-MX.scene: Ana necesita entrada sin escalones; A solo escaleras, B entrada accesible funcional.
help: Revisa accesibilidad esencial antes de comparar precio.

feedback.met: Una entrada inutilizable no cumple el requisito de acceso.
feedback.not_yet: Revisa accesibilidad esencial antes de comparar precio.

pt-BR.scene: Ana precisa de entrada sem degraus; A só tem escadas, B tem entrada acessível funcional.
help: Confira acesso essencial antes de comparar preço.

feedback.met: Uma entrada inutilizável não atende ao requisito de acesso.
feedback.not_yet: Confira acesso essencial antes de comparar preço.

en-US.scene: Shift starts before dawn; A’s service begins afterward, B runs before the shift.
help: Match transport availability to the actual schedule.

feedback.met: A route must operate when the journey is needed.
feedback.not_yet: Match transport availability to the actual schedule.

feedback.met: Una ruta debe funcionar cuando se necesita viajar.
feedback.not_yet: Ajusta disponibilidad de transporte al horario real.

pt-BR.scene: Turno começa antes do amanhecer; serviço A começa depois, B funciona antes do turno.

feedback.met: Uma rota deve funcionar quando a viagem é necessária.
feedback.not_yet: Ajuste transporte disponível ao horário real.

en-US.prompt: Can this option be called feasible?
en-US.scene: Rent fits the budget, but required accessible transport is unavailable.
help: Evaluate the combined housing and transport arrangement.

feedback.met: Affordable rent does not fix unavailable essential access.
feedback.not_yet: Evaluate the combined housing and transport arrangement.

es-MX.scene: Renta cabe en presupuesto, pero falta transporte accesible requerido.
help: Evalúa el conjunto de vivienda y transporte.

feedback.met: Renta asequible no resuelve falta de acceso esencial.
feedback.not_yet: Evalúa el conjunto de vivienda y transporte.

feedback.not_yet: Avalie o conjunto de moradia e transporte.

help: Obtain journey timing before declaring the route feasible.

feedback.met: Unknown timing prevents checking the arrival constraint.
feedback.not_yet: Obtain journey timing before declaring the route feasible.
